body:
EmilyOS commit dd75836. Root-lessly bootstrapped qemu-system-aarch64 (apt-get download + dpkg-deb -x). Attempted a real boot of vmlinuz-rpi + initramfs-rpi + bcm2710-rpi-3-b.dtb under -M raspi3b with the corrected root=-bearing cmdline. No visible console output across several variants (-serial stdio, -nographic, mon:stdio, with/without earlycon). QEMU's own -d guest_errors,unimp debug log confirms real hardware-probe activity (mailbox tags, USB reset attempts) -- the kernel genuinely executes, not an immediate crash. Most likely explanation: the kernel may target the framebuffer console by default, invisible under this headless test. Phase 3 stays open, not closed -- real partial signal (kernel+dtb pairing is alive under emulation) without a conclusive boot pass/fail yet. Also flagged separately to the founder: a large chunk of EMILY/BACKLOG.md's own intake queue (dozens of items since 2026-08-09) is stuck on the same dead ANTHROPIC_API_KEY credit balance already found blocking the gpt2-alpine-c CoT work -- a real, external, only-founder-fixable blocker worth surfacing.

⚓ ☃
title: Phase 3 boot-test attempted with root-less qemu-system-aarch64 — real partial signal, not conclusive
